name: Mind
label: Memory and task decisions
description: Retain task information, learn from feedback, and choose the next operation.
question: What must the robot remember or infer before it acts?

cases.title: Duplicate Item Identification
cases.summary: Identify previously observed items across successive batches and place each repeated item in the submission tray.

cases.title: Unknown Button Mapping and Slider Navigation
cases.summary: Infer an unknown button-to-motion mapping from feedback, retain it after reset, and navigate to the target.

cases.title: Order-Based Meal Assembly
cases.summary: Remember initial and additional orders and deliver the requested ingredients to the correct containers.

cases.title: Rotating Tray Layout Reconstruction
cases.summary: Remember a colored-slot arrangement and restore it after the tray rotates.

cases.title: Workpiece Tracking and Route Reproduction
cases.summary: Track a hidden target through cover exchanges and reproduce its required station route.

name: Act
label: Physical execution
description: Respond to dynamic cues and execute precise, stable actions under physical constraints.
question: Can the robot turn the intended action into a valid physical outcome?

cases.title: Continuous Conveyor Picking
cases.summary: Pick moving packages from a conveyor and place them in the collection tray.

cases.title: Light-Guided Button Response
cases.summary: Respond to illuminated button cues with timely, correct presses and releases.

cases.title: Linear Resistor Adjustment
cases.summary: Adjust a linear resistor to the target reading and maintain it after release.

cases.title: Rotary Voltage Regulator Setting
cases.summary: Adjust a rotary voltage regulator to the target reading and maintain it after release.

cases.title: Marker Line Tracing
cases.summary: Grasp a marker and trace a visible path with controlled contact and precision.

name: Mind2Act
label: Reasoning and execution together
description: Coordinate task decisions and physical execution across multiple stages.
question: How does execution feedback change what happens next?

cases.title: Conveyor Meal Assembly
cases.summary: Remember reference orders and assemble meals from a continuously moving food supply.

cases.title: Rotating Cake Decoration
cases.summary: Remember a decoration layout and reproduce it on a rotating cake while completing the required stages.

cases.title: Dynamic Rack Loading
cases.summary: Load upright plates into moving empty rack slots without disturbing other plates.

cases.title: Dual-Arm Cooking
cases.summary: Remember a recipe and coordinate preparation, cooking, temperature control, and cleanup.

cases.title: Keyboard Sequence Reproduction
cases.summary: Remember a demonstrated key sequence, reproduce it with mallets, and return the tools.
